entries.reason: Development-only transitive dependency of @opengsd/gsd-pi (devDependency, never shipped or deployed); extract-zip 2.0.1 is the latest upstream release with no patched version for either symlink-traversal advisory. Re-evaluate when upstream releases a fix or before this expiry.

Transitive build/dev tooling dependency (eslint, flat-cache, glob, jake/workbox). Not reachable by untrusted user input in production runtime. Re-evaluate when upstream tooling bumps minimatch/brace-expansion or before this expiry.

Transitive dependency of micromatch/chokidar in dev and build tooling. Not exposed to untrusted input in production runtime. Re-evaluate when upstream tooling bumps micromatch/braces or before this expiry.
HTTP client used strictly for known backend AI and external services with pre-sanitized payloads; HTTP/2 and fetch adapters are not used. Re-evaluate on next major axios upgrade cycle.
Transitive transport layer dependency of socket.io 4.7.2. WebSocket connections are authenticated and fronted by reverse-proxy timeouts and rate limiting.
Used for transactional email delivery. Destination addresses are strictly validated by Zod email schema prior to invocation; free-text addresses are never supplied to addressparser.
Transitive dependency of dev bot integrations (@discordjs/rest, discord.js). BalancedPool TLS option dropping and raw unrequested WebSocket subprotocols are not used in production services.
